user.title: Novafos water (Watts On)
user.description: Run tools/login.py to get a refresh token, then paste it here. Leave device IDs empty to auto-detect water meters.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Watts again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved Watts login no longer works. Run `python tools/login.py login`, then paste the new refresh token here.

error.invalid_auth: Refresh token rejected, log in again with tools/login.py
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Watts backend
error.no_devices: No water meter found. Enter the device ID manually.
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Watts account than the one configured

abort.already_configured: This Watts account is already configured
abort.reauth_successful: Logged in again. The integration is reloading.

legacy_statistic_id.title: Energy dashboard uses the old Novafos statistic
legacy_statistic_id.description: Since version 0.5.0 this integration writes its hourly water history to `{new}`. Your Energy dashboard still uses `{old}`, which no longer updates. Open Settings > Dashboards > Energy and pick `{new}` for water consumption. Afterwards you can delete `{old}` in Developer tools > Statistics. This message goes away on the next restart once the old statistic is no longer used.
